authority_owner_state.name: authority_owner_state
authority_owner_state.value:
("rdws_authority"."owner"."generation" IS NULL) = ("rdws_authority"."owner"."proof_digest" IS NULL)
        AND ("rdws_authority"."owner"."generation" IS NULL OR "rdws_authority"."owner"."ticket_digest" IS NULL)
        AND ("rdws_authority"."owner"."managed" OR ("rdws_authority"."owner"."generation" IS NULL AND "rdws_authority"."owner"."ticket_digest" IS NULL))

session_model_first_write_state.name: session_model_first_write_state
session_model_first_write_state.value:
("session_model_first_write"."state" = 'prepared' and "session_model_first_write"."submitted_at" is null) or
          ("session_model_first_write"."state" = 'submitted' and "session_model_first_write"."submitted_at" is not null)

session_prompt_dispatch_input.name: session_prompt_dispatch_input
session_prompt_dispatch_input.value:
char_length("session_prompt_dispatch"."request_id") between 1 and 128 and
          "session_prompt_dispatch"."input_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and
          char_length("session_prompt_dispatch"."provider") between 1 and 160 and
          char_length("session_prompt_dispatch"."model") between 1 and 160

session_prompt_dispatch_ticket.name: session_prompt_dispatch_ticket
session_prompt_dispatch_ticket.value:
("session_prompt_dispatch"."state" = 'reserved' and "session_prompt_dispatch"."host_generation" is null and "session_prompt_dispatch"."peer_nonce" is null and "session_prompt_dispatch"."lease_expires_at" is null)
          or ("session_prompt_dispatch"."state" in ('pending', 'accepted') and "session_prompt_dispatch"."host_generation" is not null and
              "session_prompt_dispatch"."peer_nonce" is not null and char_length("session_prompt_dispatch"."peer_nonce") between 1 and 128 and "session_prompt_dispatch"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

session_prompt_dispatch_observation.name: session_prompt_dispatch_observation
session_prompt_dispatch_observation.value:
("session_prompt_dispatch"."state" in ('reserved', 'pending') and "session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_seq" is null and "session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_message_id" is null)
          or ("session_prompt_dispatch"."state" = 'accepted' and "session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_seq" is not null and "session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_seq" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and
              "session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_message_id" is not null and char_length("session_prompt_dispatch"."accepted_message_id") between 1 and 128)
